messages.content:
Rewrite these unverified audio-model observations into non-speech captions
for Deaf/hard-of-hearing viewers. These observations are the ONLY factual input;
do not add sounds, source identities, emotion, visuals, plot or interpretations.
Do not treat observations as independently verified. Remove speculative causes
or moods. Preserve multiple audible sound types. Three texts per observation:
essential (short labels), balanced (brief description), detailed (more of the
already supplied acoustic detail, at most 25 words). All <= 278 characters, no
brackets, markup or newlines. If the observation explicitly reports no non-speech
sounds, return null texts for that id. Return only a JSON object with key captions,
an array of objects with EXACT keys id, essential, balanced, detailed. Preserve
every input id exactly once. Do not generate timestamps. Observations:
[{"id": "0", "observation": "A loud engine starts, followed by a deep rumble and a high-pitched whine, indicating a powerful machine powering up."}, {"id": "15", "observation": "A loud, continuous mechanical rumble and metallic clanking sound, resembling a large vehicle or machinery in motion, dominates the audio."}, {"id": "30", "observation": "The non-speech sounds include a high-pitched squeak, a low-frequency rumble, and a sharp metallic clank."}, {"id": "45", "observation": "A low, sustained electronic drone with a faint, high-pitched, rhythmic ticking sound is audible throughout the recording."}, {"id": "75", "observation": "A continuous low-frequency hum is present, accompanied by intermittent high-pitched bird chirps and a brief metallic clink."}, {"id": "90", "observation": "A sharp metallic click is followed by a sustained, high-pitched electronic whine, then a deep, resonant rumble."}, {"id": "105", "observation": "A loud, metallic impact and scraping sound occur, followed by a deep, resonant rumble and a low-frequency hum."}, {"id": "120", "observation": "The non-speech sounds include a continuous low-frequency hum and intermittent rustling, likely from fabric or movement in a quiet indoor environment."}]
